evidence.excerpt: In this work, we present Skillware, an open architectural framework and capability registry that formally separates what an agent wants to do from how that task is executed.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Evaluating 23 frontier and open-weight models across 368 benchmark conditions, we show that small local models (3B to 8B parameters) equipped with Skillware consistently outperform unequipped frontier models on complex multi-step workflows.
